tiers.other_route_en: VUMC may still help through Catastrophic Financial Assistance if your unreimbursed VUMC medical bills in one year are more than your household's yearly income; you would still pay 15% to 30% of your yearly gross income (Appendix F).

application_window.text_template_en: Apply by {date} if this is your first bill after leaving the hospital; if not, your deadline is earlier. VUMC's application period is 240 days after the first post-discharge billing statement.

citation.source: Vanderbilt University Medical Center Financial Assistance Policy (approved September 2026; tables effective 7/1/2026)

documents.label_en: VUMC's own Financial Assistance Application form (fill it in; this app never asks for your SSN)

citation.source: VUMC Financial Assistance Application (English)

documents.label_en: Tax returns and supporting schedules for the previous 2 years

citation.source: VUMC Financial Assistance Application (English)

documents.label_en: Pay stubs for the most recent 3 months, and any Social Security, disability, W-2 or unemployment papers

citation.source: VUMC Financial Assistance Application (English)

documents.label_en: If you have no current tax return: VUMC may accept a W-9, 1099, food stamp or disability award letters, other official government income documents, an employer letter, or one year of bank statements

coverage_period.text_en: An approval covers your unpaid VUMC bills for eligible services, from the earliest one, until six months after the approval date.

citation.source: Vanderbilt University Medical Center Financial Assistance Policy (approved September 2026; tables effective 7/1/2026)

conditions.text_en: Above 3.5 times the poverty guideline: VUMC may still help through Catastrophic Financial Assistance if your unreimbursed VUMC medical bills in one year are more than your household's yearly income.

citation.source: Vanderbilt University Medical Center Financial Assistance Policy (approved September 2026; tables effective 7/1/2026)

conditions.text_en: With Catastrophic Financial Assistance you still pay part of the bill: from 15% of yearly gross income (income up to $50,000) to 30% (income over $100,000).

citation.source: Vanderbilt University Medical Center Financial Assistance Policy (approved September 2026; tables effective 7/1/2026)

conditions.text_en: Some services are not covered at all, for example cosmetic or other not medically necessary services, Vanderbilt Birth Center services, and transplant services for uninsured patients (except fulminant hepatic failure). See Appendix A.

citation.source: Vanderbilt University Medical Center Financial Assistance Policy (approved September 2026; tables effective 7/1/2026)

conditions.text_en: VUMC staff decide each application case by case; the tiers above are the policy's income guidelines, not a promise.

citation.source: Vanderbilt University Medical Center Financial Assistance Policy (approved September 2026; tables effective 7/1/2026)

conditions.text_en: VUMC counts as family: you, your married or common-law spouse (even if living elsewhere), and your children under 18 who live at home. Your household size may differ from what you typed.

citation.source: Vanderbilt University Medical Center Financial Assistance Policy (approved September 2026; tables effective 7/1/2026)

conditions.text_en: VUMC tests adjusted gross income (AGI) from your tax return, for the current or prior year. This estimate used the yearly income you typed.

citation.source: Vanderbilt University Medical Center Financial Assistance Policy (approved September 2026; tables effective 7/1/2026)

conditions.text_en: The deadline counts from the FIRST bill after you left the hospital. VUMC encourages applying within 120 days of that bill.

citation.source: Vanderbilt University Medical Center Financial Assistance Policy (approved September 2026; tables effective 7/1/2026)

conditions.text_en: If you are enrolled in TennCare or another state Medicaid program, VUMC gives a 100% discount automatically.

citation.source: Vanderbilt University Medical Center Financial Assistance Policy (approved September 2026; tables effective 7/1/2026)

conditions.text_en: VUMC also has an Alternate Charity Process (for example SNAP, WIC, homelessness, or TennCare spend-down) that does not need this application.

citation.source: Vanderbilt University Medical Center Financial Assistance Policy (approved September 2026; tables effective 7/1/2026)

conditions.text_en: VUMC says the 85% discount is applied "in percentage increments based upon income and family size"; ask VUMC what your exact discount would be.

citation.source: Vanderbilt University Medical Center Financial Assistance Policy (approved September 2026; tables effective 7/1/2026)

conditions.text_en: Not every provider in a VUMC building is covered; VUMC publishes a list of providers covered by this policy.

citation.source: Vanderbilt University Medical Center Financial Assistance Policy (approved September 2026; tables effective 7/1/2026)

conditions.text_en: Vanderbilt Clarksville Hospital has different terms (Appendix C); this estimate does not cover it.
